suggested_fix: The TWC Emergency Medical Response Service Staffing Program gives grants to DSHS-licensed EMS providers to fund scholarships, including for trainees pursuing EMT-Basic (not only current employees). It covers tuition and NREMT exam fees if the participant passes, and excludes books and uniforms. The program page lists a Sept 1 - Oct 31, 2026 window for courses starting after Jan 1, 2027, and says applications run on a rolling basis (two months open, one month closed), so a further window is likely; check TWC for current dates. Students cannot apply directly: the EMS provider applies.
